name: Cloud Log Acquisition & Analysis
description: Ability to acquire and analyse cloud platform logs for forensic investigations. Covers AWS CloudTrail, Azure Activity/Entra ID logs, GCP Audit Logs, Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Log, and cloud-native logging infrastructure. Includes understanding log retention, API-based collection, and translating cloud events into investigative narratives.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to cloud log forensics

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands what cloud platform logs exist and their forensic significance
evidence: Can describe the major cloud log types (CloudTrail, Azure Activity, GCP Audit)
Understands cloud shared responsibility model implications for forensic evidence availability
Can explain why cloud log retention policies affect investigation capability

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Collects and searches cloud logs using platform tools and APIs under supervision
evidence: Queried AWS CloudTrail logs via console and CLI to identify IAM actions under guidance
Collected Microsoft 365 Unified Audit Logs for email and SharePoint investigations
Searched Azure Activity Logs and Entra ID sign-in logs for suspicious authentication events
Documented cloud log acquisition scope, timestamps, and hash verification

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently acquires and analyses cloud logs to reconstruct attacker activity and produces investigation reports
evidence: Independently investigated cloud security incidents using logs in 5+ engagements
Reconstructed attacker activity timelines from CloudTrail or equivalent logs
Identified credential compromise, privilege escalation, and data access events from cloud logs
Produced cloud forensic reports that met lab and legal standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles multi-cloud investigations; develops log correlation queries; addresses log gaps and anti-forensic log manipulation
evidence: Investigated incidents spanning multiple cloud providers and SaaS platforms
Identified evidence of log tampering or anti-forensic techniques (CloudTrail disabling, log deletion)
Developed automated log collection and correlation scripts for cloud forensic triage
Mentors junior analysts on cloud log analysis and investigation methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines cloud forensics methodology; researches new cloud log artifacts; advises on cloud logging architecture for forensic readiness
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's cloud forensic log analysis methodology
Advises organisations on cloud logging architecture to ensure forensic readiness
Published research on cloud forensic artifacts or investigation techniques
Trains teams on cloud forensics across AWS, Azure, and GCP platforms

assessment_methods.description: Given a simulated cloud compromise scenario with provided log exports, reconstruct the attacker timeline, identify compromised resources, and produce an investigation report
Review cloud forensic investigation reports from recent engagements for log coverage completeness and analytical accuracy
